title: Notification history - a button showing the last five toasts
description:
A toast is the only record of what happened, and it is gone in seconds. Fabio, 2026-08-11: "a lot of times the user misses them and doesn't know what happened." MPI-542 fixed the READING window (duration now scales with the message), but a toast the user was not looking at is still unrecoverable.

Shape: a notifications button that shows the last five, most recent first, with each one's variant and text. Candidate homes: the status bar (docs/shell.md owns the slots) or beside the existing header controls.

Open questions for whoever takes it: does it hold five or a time window; does it survive a workspace change or only a session; does an unseen toast leave the button marked. History has to be captured where toasts are RAISED (the ui:warning / ui:error / ui:success events), not inside MpiToast - a toast that was queued out or dismissed early must still be in the list.

Next version, not 1.4.1.
